blocks.text:
Travel between distant stops on the itinerary is arranged by private transport and aircraft. The programme includes private guides, high-end hotels and several experiences that offer a different way to see famous places. A helicopter flight over Vinicunca replaces a long hike, the Hiram Bingham train makes the journey to Machu Picchu an experience in its own right, and you will see the Nazca Lines from the air.

## What to expect on the journey

### Lima: gastronomy, the old centre and the Larco Museum

The first part of the trip takes place in Lima. You will see the city's colonial centre and the modern district of Miraflores overlooking the Pacific Ocean, and visit Santo Domingo Monastery and the Larco Museum. The museum holds more than 50,000 objects of pre-Columbian art.

Dinners at Rafael and Central restaurants are planned. Dinner is paid for separately.

### An Amazon cruise aboard Aria Amazon

From Lima, you will fly to Iquitos and embark on a 4-day / 3-night cruise aboard Aria Amazon with full board. The vessel has 16 suites with panoramic windows, air conditioning and sitting areas. Guests have access to a jacuzzi, fitness facilities and massage services.

The cruise includes jungle outings, kayaking, fishing and wildlife watching. Chef Pedro Miguel Schiaffino oversees the cuisine on board, and premium drinks and onboard service are included in the programme.

### Cusco and the Sacred Valley

After the Amazon, the route continues to Cusco, the former capital of the Inca Empire, at an altitude of more than 3,400 m. From the airport, you will travel to the Sacred Valley and stay at Explora Sacred Valley. A 4-day / 3-night programme with full board is planned here.

In the valley, you can choose excursions from the hotel's programme and discover the region's nature, Andean communities and traditional crafts.

### Machu Picchu aboard the Hiram Bingham train

You will travel to Machu Picchu on the Hiram Bingham train. The carriages have panoramic windows, and a late breakfast is served on the way. On arrival, a private bus transfer and a tour of the archaeological site are included.

You will return on the same train, with dinner served on board. After your return, you will stay at Belmond Palacio Nazarenas in Cusco.

### A helicopter flight over Rainbow Mountain Vinicunca

One day is devoted to a helicopter excursion over Vinicunca. The flight lasts 1 hour 20 minutes, including around 10 minutes directly over the mountain. This allows you to see the multicoloured slopes from above without a long hike to an altitude of around 5,200 m.

### Lake Titicaca

In Puno, you will stay at Titilaka on the shores of Lake Titicaca. The programme lasts 3 days / 2 nights with full board. It includes boat outings to the floating Uros Islands, trips around the surrounding area, and an introduction to local life and traditional weaving.

### Uyuni Salt Flat and the Altiplano

From Peru, the route continues into Bolivia. You will fly to Uyuni via La Paz and stay at Kachi Lodge, in a Luxury Dome on the edge of the salt flat.

The salt flat lies at an altitude of around 3,600 m. In the dry season, its white surface is covered with a geometric pattern of salt cracks, while in the rainy season a thin layer of water turns the plain into a vast mirror.

The programme also includes Incahuasi Island, Colchani, the salt hotel-museum and the "Eyes of Water". An optional day takes you across the Altiplano, visiting the Colorada, Cañapa, Hedionda, Chiarcota and Honda lagoons, Ollagüe Volcano and the Chiguana salt flat.

### The Nazca Lines and the Ballestas Islands

A separate flight excursion is planned before your return home. You will travel by Grand Caravan to see the Nazca Lines from the air, then fly to Pisco and continue to the Ballestas Islands aboard a private yacht.

Along the coast, you may see sea lions, pelicans, Humboldt penguins and other birds. Drinks and snacks on the yacht are included.

## Route gallery

The gallery features:

- Belmond Miraflores Park in Lima.
- The Amazon jungle around Iquitos.
- Kachi Lodge on the Uyuni Salt Flat.
- Machu Picchu.
- Titilaka on Lake Titicaca and the floating Uros Islands.
- The Nazca geoglyphs from the air.
- Rainbow Mountain Vinicunca.
- Lima's colonial architecture.
- The Belmond Hiram Bingham train.
- Flamingos in Laguna Colorada.
- Cusco.
- Lima's coastline.
- An Aqua Expeditions cruise on the Amazon.
- Residents of the Amazon region.
